Synopsis:
When you arrive on the rooftop after making Ketheric vulnerable, he will be shivering and furious at the fact that his invulnerability has been taken from him. The Tower is under attack and he's in a desperate state. He will fight the player, unless by a huge stroke of luck the player convinces him to surrender. Edge-case path: Audience with the Absolute (captured Nightsong then messed up Z'rell)

Cluster Contexts:
- MOO_Assault_BossFightIntro.json: The player has reached the roof after whatever actions made Ketheric mortal — his invulnerability has been stripped and he now realizes it, shaking with fury and desperation. The tower is under assault (tremors and chaos from Nightsong’s attack are evident), so Ketheric is unstable and prepared to fight the player rather than surrender unless the player miraculously talks him down. Off‑screen context may include the Haven briefing with Jaheira/Isobel that set the mission to “make him mortal,” and earlier disturbances referenced in other scenes (the windmill/gnome incident or the Moonlantern/pixie event) that drew extra attention. On an evil route variant, this area can instead reflect the “Audience with the Absolute” outcome (Nightsong held captive, Z’rell/Balthazar beats and cultists present), which will change who is actually on the roof and how Ketheric reacts.
- MOO_Audience_WaitingKetheric.json: Audience path, which means Nightsong was captured in SHA. Ketheric is on the roof. This is afterthe bigger interactive dialog - when the player must go to the altar

Ketheric delivers a short speech before he dies.- If Nightsong's corpse is present in the chamber, she will revive. If she is alive by this point she will comment on finally being rid of Ketheric.
- COL_Barracks_MistressOfSouls_HighAlert.json: If you attacked Ketheric on the rooftop of Moonrise Tower, the Myrkulites in the Colony Barracks will be on high alert. If she spots you, she will assume you are one of the traitors that attacked Ketheric - but you can try to convince her otherwise.

context: The player has just reached the Moonrise Tower roof after whatever actions in prior scenes removed Ketheric’s invulnerability; he’s realized he’s mortal, is shivering and furious, and the tower is under assault (tremors and chaos from Nightsong’s attack are evident). Off‑screen the party was briefed to “make him mortal” (e.g., by Jaheira/Isobel) and earlier disturbances in the region drew extra attention to the tower. In the normal path Ketheric is desperate and will attack the player rather than surrender unless the player improbably talks him down. In an edge‑case “Audience with the Absolute” variant, Nightsong may be captured and other cultists (Z’rell/Balthazar, nameless minions) will alter who’s on the roof and how Ketheric reacts.
